description: The OpenSearch analyzer configuration. Stores the full definition of how text is analyzed.

charFilters.description: Named character filter definitions. Keys are filter names, values are JSON-serialized filter config objects.

tokenizer.description: The tokenizer name (e.g., 'standard', 'whitespace'). For custom tokenizers, define in 'tokenizerConfig'.

tokenizerConfig.description: JSON-serialized custom tokenizer configuration object. Must include a 'type' field. Example: {"type":"edge_ngram","min_gram":2,"max_gram":20,"token_chars":["letter","digit"]}

tokenFilters.description: Named token filter definitions. Keys are filter names, values are JSON-serialized filter config objects.

filterOrder.description: Ordered list of token filter names to apply. Can reference built-in filters (e.g., 'lowercase') or custom ones defined in 'tokenFilters'.

charFilterOrder.description: Ordered list of character filter names to apply.

synonymAware.description: Whether the synonym token filter should be appended when synonyms are configured.
